output.summary: A unicellular green alga found especially in extremely salty waters, Dunaliella salina lacks a rigid cell wall and can accumulate enough beta-carotene to appear orange-red. It is commercially cultivated for beta-carotene and used as a pro-vitamin A food supplement.
output.edibilityNote: Used as a pro-vitamin A food supplement because it contains abundant beta-carotene; it may also provide vitamin B12.
